title: g_! of a quasi-coherent module on the lisse-etale (flat-fppf) site is quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Reduction to a global presentation: the site-local definition gives an etale (fppf) covering on which the pullback has a global presentation, the functorial lemma transports g_! through the coverings, the descent lemma for qc reduces the claim to the globally presented case, and g_! (a left adjoint, hence colimit-continuous) preserves the presenting free exact sequence, with g_!O = O_X from the structure-sheaf lemma.
